notes.title: Added Borderless Window Mode!
notes.content: This patch adds Borderless Window Mode, so that the game runs in "full screen" mode but as a window.

notes.title: Fixed Level 24-10
notes.content: Thanks to Amjara for the bug report, this little update fixes level 24-10.

notes.title: Gallery Feature Added
notes.content: Unlock stunning backgrounds as you progress through the levels! Access the gallery to view your unlocked designs and set them as your wallpaper to keep the adventure alive wherever you go!
